title: Close the state-sync parity gap on turn end and correct two false lines in the Pi config reference
action: This is a fix-first cell for a gap the earlier cells left, found by the orchestrator while verifying pib-5. FIRST, the parity gap. Derive from packages/bee/hooks/claude-hooks.json which rules the Claude belt fires on its turn-end event, then read the Pi belt's turn-end handler and list which of those it actually calls. One of them is missing on Pi even though the Pi event is a perfectly good carrier for it — the belt calls that rule on tool results only. Wire it on the turn-end event too, passing the Claude event name the manifest pairs it with, ADVISORY and fail-open like its neighbours, inside the existing handler and without disturbing what already runs there. Read the rule's own implementation first so you know what it does with a payload that carries no tool fields, and pass only what that event honestly carries. SECOND, the two false lines in docs/config-reference.md, both in the Pi guard belt section that pib-5 wrote: one row claims session-close flushes state before compaction, but the rule's PreCompact arm returns the undecidable value and does nothing observable except a fail-open stderr line — rewrite that row to say what the code does, and say plainly that the row exists so the belt is ready when the rule's PreCompact arm becomes real. The other line lists the rule you are wiring as having no Pi carrier, which your own change makes false — move it into the wired table with the event you wired it on. While you are in that section, re-read every remaining row against the belt and correct any other row that does not match the code. THIRD, extend the parity test with a probe that the turn-end handler calls every rule the Claude manifest fires on its turn-end event, so this gap cannot reopen silently.

truths: The Pi turn-end handler calls every rule the Claude manifest fires on its own turn-end event, and a probe asserts that set rather than a hand-written list
The newly wired rule receives the Claude event name the manifest pairs it with, and only the payload fields that event honestly carries
The config reference no longer claims the belt flushes state before compaction; it states what the PreCompact row actually does today and why it exists
No row in the Pi section of the config reference contradicts the belt source
The new call is advisory and fail-open, and the blocking path is untouched
